mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals labor market weakness that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime where the federal funds rate rises above 0.5%, the increased cost of capital depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1100 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST falls below 1100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in payroll employment and decreases in unemployment rate signal a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime where housing starts exceed 1200 thousand units, strong residential construction activity drives consumer spending and business investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200 for 3 consecutive months.
